Developments in Christian Thought: Pluralism, Liberation Theology, Gender — a core area of A-Level Religious Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

What is the central principle of situation ethics?
options: Nirvana is the name of a Buddhist god.
The only intrinsically good thing is agape love; rules can be broken if doing so produces the most loving outcome in the situation.
You should do whatever feels right in the moment.
Situation ethics says rules should always be followed.

mcqs.q: How do samsara, karma and moksha fit together in Hindu thought?
options: Moksha is the Hindu word for heaven.
Situation ethics says rules should always be followed.
Samsara, karma and moksha are three separate Hindu deities.
Samsara is the cycle of rebirth; karma is the law of action and consequence that drives rebirth; moksha is liberation from samsara — these form a connected chain, not three independent ideas.
